info.title: TTS Bandmate API
info.description:
The TTS Bandmate Band API allows external integrations to read and manage bookings
and events for a band. Authentication uses a **Bearer token** issued per band.

## Authentication

All endpoints require an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Tokens are
scoped to a single band and carry fine-grained permissions.

## Permissions

Each token is granted one or more permissions at issuance:

| Permission | Grants access to |
|---|---|
| `api:read-bookings` | GET /booked-dates, GET /bookings, GET /bookings/{id} |
| `api:write-bookings` | POST /bookings, PUT /bookings/{id}, PATCH /bookings/{id}, DELETE /bookings/{id}, POST /bookings/{id}/contacts |
| `api:read-events` | GET /events |
| `api:read-pricing` | POST /price-estimate |

## Date Filtering

`/booked-dates` and `/events` support the same set of query parameters for filtering
by date. All dates must be in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Parameters can be combined
(e.g. `from` + `to` for a range).

get.description:
Returns bookings for the authenticated band with optional date filtering. Results are ordered by date ascending, then start time ascending.

**Required permission:** `api:read-bookings`

Returns all bookings for the authenticated band, ordered by date descending. Includes associated events, contacts, and payments.

**Required permission:** `api:read-bookings`

post.description:
Creates a new booking for the authenticated band, the same way the TTS web and mobile apps do: the booking gets its contract record (seeded with the band's initial contract terms) and one event whose timeline (load in, soundcheck, quiet; plus ceremony and dances for weddings) and details are generated from the event type, assigned to the band's default roster, with the event value equal to the booking price. The end time is calculated from `start_time` + `duration` (hours). `status` defaults to `draft`.

Pass the client as `contact` (and/or more in `contacts`): the band's existing contact with that email is reused, otherwise one is created. `is_primary` defaults to true for the first contact.

**Required permission:** `api:write-bookings`

duration.description: Duration in whole hours (1–24). Used to calculate end_time.

contact.description: The client to attach to the booking (optional).

get.description:
Returns a single booking. Returns 404 if the booking does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated band.

**Required permission:** `api:read-bookings`

put.description:
Full update of an existing booking. Only fields provided are validated and updated.

**Required permission:** `api:write-bookings`

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a booking. This action cannot be undone.

**Required permission:** `api:write-bookings`

patch.description:
Partial update — send only the fields you want to change.

**Required permission:** `api:write-bookings`

post.summary: Add a contact to a booking
post.description:
Attaches a client contact to the booking. The band's existing contact with this email is reused (its name and phone are left unchanged); otherwise a new contact is created for the band. Re-adding an attached contact updates its `role` and `is_primary`. `is_primary` defaults to true when the booking has no other primary contact. Returns 404 if the booking does not exist or does not belong to the authenticated band.

**Required permission:** `api:write-bookings`

get.description:
Returns events for the authenticated band from **both** bookings and legacy band events (polymorphic). Results are ordered by date ascending, then time ascending.

**Required permission:** `api:read-events`

post.description:
Returns a suggested price (with a low/high range, confidence, and an itemised breakdown) for a prospective booking, based on the band's booking history and pricing rules. Read-only: nothing is created or saved.

If `distance_miles` is omitted and `venue_address` is given, the distance from the band's address is looked up to calculate travel/lodging fees.

When the band has no priced booking history and no manual base rate for the event type, `estimate`, `low`, `high` and `baseline` are `null` and `warnings` contains a `no_baseline` entry.

**Required permission:** `api:read-pricing`

start_time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Used with end_time to compute duration

duration_hours.description: Used when start/end time are not both given (0.25-24). Defaults to the standard length for the event type

venue_address.description: Used to look up the travel distance when distance_miles is omitted (max 500 chars)

distance_miles.description: One-way distance to the venue in miles (0-10000)

add_ons.description: Add-on keys from the band's pricing settings

exclude_booking_id.description: Don't flag this booking's own date as a conflict

estimate.description: Suggested price, rounded to the band's round_to step

key.description: baseline, season, day_of_week, special_date, duration, short_notice, travel, lodging, or addon:<key>

warnings.message: You already have a booking on May 15, 2027.

AppliedFilters.description: Echoes back any date filters that were applied

eventable_type.description: Whether this event originates from a booking or a legacy band event

eventable_id.description: ID of the parent booking or band event

end_time.description: HH:MM 24-hour format (update only; ignored on create)

email.description: The band's existing contact with this email is reused; otherwise a new contact is created.

is_primary.description: Defaults to true when the booking has no other primary contact.
